title: Console Home ignores the user's saved language on a browser with no local language entry; app pages honour it
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible, reproduced on two fresh loads).

QA-source: #32135 · approvals.account-app-entry · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

A user's saved language is ignored by the console Home page on a browser that has no local language entry yet. App pages honour it; Home does not.

## Reproduction (framework ff04ad81, stock showcase)

1. Sign in, open the avatar menu and switch the language to 简体中文 (this writes `PATCH sys_user {locale}`).
2. Open `/_console/home` in a fresh browser context with the same session but no `objectui-locale` in localStorage (another device, or cleared storage).

- Expected: Home renders in Chinese, from the user's saved preference.
- Actual: Home renders in English, also after a reload. Opening any app page renders Chinese and writes `objectui-locale=zh-Hans`; going back to Home then shows Chinese.

## Reach

The console Home page, every user who set a language and signs in on another device.

## Why it matters

The first screen a user sees on a new device ignores the language they chose, and only fixes itself after they open an app.

## Reader

Triage first touch; the fix lands in `ui/` (Home's locale hydration from the server-side preference).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack home locale language preference` (35, open and closed): no card for this behaviour.
